verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent agent-facing aids: a scaffolded AGENTS.md, Markdown versions of docs routes, and /llms-full.txt. None of these is an MCP server an agent can connect to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
